name: Remove metadata cascade policy
description: Remove metadata cascade policy Deletes a metadata cascade policy. DELETE /2.0/metadata_cascade_policies/{metadata_cascade_policy_id}

name: List metadata cascade policies
description: List metadata cascade policies Retrieves a list of all the metadata cascade policies that are applied to a given folder. GET /2.0/metadata_cascade_policies
context:
GET /2.0/metadata_cascade_policies
Retrieves a list of all the metadata cascade policies that are applied to a given folder. This can not be used on the root folder with ID `0`.
Required: folder_id (query) — Specifies which folder to return policies for. This can not be used on the root folder with ID `0`.
Optional: owner_enterprise_id (query) — The ID of the enterprise ID for which to find metadata cascade policies. If not specified, it defaults to the current enterprise.; marker (query) — Defines the position marker at which to begin returning results. This is used when paginating using marker-based pagination. This requires `usemarker` to be set to `true`.; offset (query) — The offset of the item at which to begin the response. Queries with offset parameter value exceeding 10000 will be rejected with a 400 response.

name: Get metadata cascade policy
description: Get metadata cascade policy Retrieve a specific metadata cascade policy assigned to a folder. GET /2.0/metadata_cascade_policies/{metadata_cascade_policy_id}

name: Create metadata cascade policy
description: Create metadata cascade policy Creates a new metadata cascade policy that applies a given metadata template to a given folder and automatically cascades it down to any files within that folder. POST /2.0/metadata_cascade_policies
context:
POST /2.0/metadata_cascade_policies
Creates a new metadata cascade policy that applies a given metadata template to a given folder and automatically cascades it down to any files within that folder. In order for the policy to be applied a metadata instance must first be applied to the folder the policy is to be applied to.
Optional: body (body)

name: Force-apply metadata cascade policy to folder
description: Force-apply metadata cascade policy to folder Force the metadata on a folder with a metadata cascade policy to be applied to all of its children. POST /2.0/metadata_cascade_policies/{metadata_cascade_policy_id}/apply
context:
POST /2.0/metadata_cascade_policies/{metadata_cascade_policy_id}/apply
Force the metadata on a folder with a metadata cascade policy to be applied to all of its children. This can be used after creating a new cascade policy to enforce the metadata to be cascaded down to all existing files within that folder.
Required: metadata_cascade_policy_id (path) — The ID of the cascade policy to force-apply.
Optional: body (body)
